_note: Story 064 (hard clients only): some hard clients have a hangnail on one finger. The Nipper (in the Clean row) trims it: hold on it steadily for trimMs. A quick snip (released before slipMs) or a hard press (pressure above roughPressure, touch or pen) slips: a tiny red dot (never gory), her ouch line and slipMood. First aid then shows: apply styptic, then a bandage (aidMood once both are done); saying sorry in the chat (sorryPattern) adds sorryMood. A hangnail still there at Done costs leftMood. trimmedMood: her thanks for a clean trim. chance: the share of hard clients with a hangnail (by a stable hash of the visit).
